posts.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Astra
posts.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra as a generational leap for computer use, coding, and cyber — first model to hit Critical cybersecurity threshold. Brockman framed it as the AGI era; Daybreak first, then Plus/Pro/Business/Enterprise and API.

posts.title: Nvidia confirms $12.9B Hugging Face buy
posts.summary: Nvidia will acquire Hugging Face for $12.93B. Huang said the hub stays multi-vendor and open — Nvidia compute won’t be required.

posts.title: VentureBeat: Welcome to the AGI era — Astra
posts.summary: VB covers Astra with Brockman’s AGI-era line: autonomous computer use across browsers/desktop, Critical cyber, Daybreak-first rollout.

posts.title: Anthropic ships Claude Fable 5.1
posts.summary: Fable/Mythos 5.1: Terminal-Bench 4.0 at 55.8% vs 42% for Fable 5; cache reads cut to $0.25/MTok (75% drop).

posts.title: Meta Muse Spark 1.3 — best config still gated
posts.summary: Muse Spark 1.3 ships big coding/agent gains; strongest max-reasoning config still in safety testing. API stays $1.25/$4.25 per MTok.

posts.title: Microsoft MAI-Transcribe-2 at $0.10/hour
posts.summary: MAI-Transcribe-2 at 10¢/hour with 60 languages, diarization, timestamps — undercuts OpenAI, Google, ElevenLabs on public batch rates.

posts.title: Accel eyes $1B Thinking Machines round at $40B
posts.summary: Accel reportedly in talks to lead a $1B raise for Mira Murati’s Thinking Machines at ≥$40B valuation.

posts.title: Abliteration.ai sells guardrail-stripped models
posts.summary: Abliteration.ai commercializes removing refusal behaviors from open-weight models, hosting abliterated GLM-5.3 via browser and API.

posts.title: Meta pays ~95% off if you share Muse usage
posts.summary: Muse Spark contributor tier: ~$0.10/$0.20 per MTok if you share prompts/outputs for training; standard stays $1.25/$4.25.

posts.title: Perplexity hybrid compute keeps secrets local
posts.summary: Perplexity Computer can hand confidential steps to on-device models on Apple silicon Macs without losing context; opt-in enterprise + Pro/Max on macOS 15+.

posts.title: ChatGPT, Grok, and Claude went down together
posts.summary: ChatGPT, Grok, and Claude hit overlapping Sep 3 outages; all recovered the same day with no confirmed shared root cause.

posts.title: Nvidia buying Hugging Face for nearly $13B
posts.summary: The Verge: Nvidia’s ~$13B Hugging Face deal; companies say the hub stays open to rival builders and clouds.

posts.title: Astra on AI/TLDR: computer-use frontier model
posts.summary: AI/TLDR’s release note: GPT-6 Astra scores 72.6% on an offline OSWorld 2.0 subset at $10/$50 per million tokens, aimed at browsers, spreadsheets, and desktop apps, with Critical cyber rating and Daybreak-first access.

posts.title: LLaDA-Image: 6B open image gen from Ant Group
posts.summary: Ant Group’s inclusionAI released LLaDA-Image, a 6B open-weight model for image generation and editing. It posts ~53.5 on Qwen-Image-Bench (EN/ZH), with a distilled Turbo checkpoint that runs in four steps.

posts.title: WeatherNext 3: DeepMind hourly weather at 5km
posts.summary: Google DeepMind’s WeatherNext 3 delivers hourly global forecasts at 5km resolution — about 5× sharper than WeatherNext 2 — and improves precipitation scores by up to 60% vs NASA IMERG, per AI/TLDR’s tracker.

posts.title: ARC Prize: Astra hits 99.9% with adapter harness
posts.summary: ARC Prize measured GPT-6 Astra at 62.7% ($26k) on ARC-AGI-3 Semi-Private via the standard harness, and 99.9% (~$19k) with a Provider Adapter harness — a reminder that harness choice can dominate raw scores.

posts.title: DeepSeek plans huge Huawei chip order
posts.summary: The Information reports DeepSeek plans to install at least 160,000 Huawei AI chips at a data center in Inner Mongolia, backing China’s push to replace Nvidia silicon under U.S. export limits. (via Prismix; The Signal blocked.)

posts.title: Nvidia may put $2.5B into Thinking Machines
posts.summary: Prismix surfaces The Information reporting Nvidia is expected to put about $2.5 billion into Mira Murati’s Thinking Machines Lab amid talks for a $5–6B raise at a ≥$40B pre-money valuation, with Accel circling the lead. (The Signal unavailable.)
